summary: Johnny Mack Morrow is an Alabama legislative candidate who ran for the Senate in District 6 in 2018. Prior to this, he served as a representative for House District 18 since at least 2014 (representing the district for approximately 24 years by that time). His political profile emphasizes pro-life, pro-family, and Second Amendment positions alongside support for public education, teacher pay increases, educator recruitment/retention, AMSTI funding, classroom resources, school safety legislation allowing armed personnel/volunteers as reserve officers, opposition to shifting funds toward charter schools, veterans programming, local industrial projects, road projects, returning TVA in-lieu-of-tax money to local groups. He is described within the memo context of a 'white-rural ideological bundle' and culturally conservative differentiation.
political_profile: Opposition to shifting public-school funds toward charter schools
School safety law sponsor (armed personnel/volunteers as reserve officers)
important_caveats: Memo notes his 2014 abortion position remains unrecovered.
